neet_phy_u13_t09_1.working: For a short magnet, B_axial = (μ0/4π)·2m/r³ and B_eq = (μ0/4π)·m/r³, so the ratio is 2:1.

neet_phy_u13_t09_4.working: A = 2m/r³ → II. B = m/r³ → IV. C = 2m/(8r³) = m/4r³ → III. D = m/8r³ → I.

neet_phy_u13_t09_5.working: A true. B false: the equatorial field is opposite to m. C true: B ∝ 1/r³, so doubling r gives 1/8. D true: for r≫l the denominator becomes r⁴. E false: the field is minimum at θ=90°.
